name: @equin/plugin-infra-paths-data-root-layout
description: The user's home (HOME_DIR) and where the data root sits in it: dataRootLayout() — named by the environment (custom), an install not yet migrated (legacy) or ~/.equin — declared once per process tree at its root by declareDataRootLayoutSync() and carried by the environment. A leaf apart from infra/paths' core so code whose identity keys records (the barrel evaluator's load guard) reads the root without keying on the paths barrel's ~300-module closure.
